rho_reference.kind_note: tuned negation-map rho on E1 (rho_full_ec, RhoWalk::negation), the protocol's primary reference; E1 is a prime-field curve, so no Frobenius; no E1 has j = 0 or 1728 (validator-checked for all 9 curves: j = 63, 357, 678, 1157, 2166, 1504, 2341, 17901, 22722), so no larger automorphism fold exists
rho_reference.unit: group operations of the arm's own group (1 GAE each) + w x native operations (IC: rel.mul + la.mul; rho: canonicalisations + partition hashes + DP lookups + DP inserts + word ops). An IC operation is a Cantor step on the word Jacobian, 4.3 to 5.7 E1 additions in best-of-N time, so every IC/rho ratio is understated; IC additions and the uncounted IC walk hash, HashMap and RNG work would only raise the IC side, so the 'above' order is conservative
rho_reference.binary_or_process: src/bin/full_jacobian_ic.rs: one process runs every IC arm, the subgroup controls and the rho on E1 of a prime
